1.english_reference: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ יוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ אַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ זֶּ֗ה

traditions.KJV: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month

1.english_reference: the children of Israel were assembled

1.english_reference: with fasting , and with sackclothes , and earth upon them .

traditions.WLC: בְּ צ֣וֹם וּ בְ שַׂקִּ֔ים וַ אֲדָמָ֖ה עֲלֵי הֶֽם

traditions.KJV: with fasting , and with sackclothes , and earth upon them .

traditions.VUL: Et separátum est semen filiórum Israel ab omni fílio alienígena :
traditions.KJV: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers ,

2.english_reference: and stood and confessed their sins ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעַמְד֗וּ וַ יִּתְוַדּוּ֙ עַל חַטֹּ֣אתֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησαν καὶ ἐξηγόρευσαν τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: et stetérunt , et confitebántur peccáta sua ,
traditions.KJV: and stood and confessed their sins ,

2.english_reference: and the iniquities of their fathers .

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲוֺנ֖וֹת אֲבֹתֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰς ἀνομίας τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et iniquitátes patrum suórum .
traditions.KJV: and the iniquities of their fathers .

3.english_reference: And they stood up in their place ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּק֨וּמוּ֙ עַל עָמְדָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησαν ἐπὶ στάσει αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Et consurrexérunt ad standum :
traditions.KJV: And they stood up in their place ,

3.english_reference: and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God [ one ] fourth part of the day ;

traditions.KJV: and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God [ one ] fourth part of the day ;

3.english_reference: and [ another ] fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the LORD their God .

traditions.WLC: וּ רְבִעִית֙ מִתְוַדִּ֣ים וּ מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֔ים לַ יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי הֶֽם

traditions.KJV: and [ another ] fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the LORD their God .

4.english_reference: Then stood up upon the stairs , of the Levites , Jeshua , and Bani , Kadmiel , Shebaniah , Bunni , Sherebiah , Bani , [ and ] Chenani ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֜קָם עַֽל מַֽעֲלֵ֣ה הַ לְוִיִּ֗ם יֵשׁ֨וּעַ וּ בָנִ֜י קַדְמִיאֵ֧ל שְׁבַנְיָ֛ה בֻּנִּ֥י שֵׁרֵבְיָ֖ה בָּנִ֣י כְנָ֑נִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ ἀναβάσει τῶν Λευειτῶν Ἰησοῦς καὶ υἱοὶ Καδμιήλ , Σαραβιὰ υἱὸς Ἀραβιά ,
traditions.VUL: Surrexérunt autem super gradum Levitárum Iósue , et Bani , et Cédmihel , Sabanía , Bonni , Sarebías , Bani , et Chánani :
traditions.KJV: Then stood up upon the stairs , of the Levites , Jeshua , and Bani , Kadmiel , Shebaniah , Bunni , Sherebiah , Bani , [ and ] Chenani ,

4.english_reference: and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God .

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּזְעֲקוּ֙ בְּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי הֶֽם

traditions.KJV: and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֣וּ הַ לְוִיִּ֡ם יֵשׁ֣וּעַ וְ֠ קַדְמִיאֵל בָּנִ֨י חֲשַׁבְנְיָ֜ה שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֤ה הֽוֹדִיָּה֙ שְׁבַנְיָ֣ה פְתַֽחְיָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴποσαν οἱ Λευεῖται Ἰησοῦς καὶ Καδμιήλ
traditions.VUL: Et dixérunt Levítæ Iósue , et Cédmihel , Bonni , Hasebnía , Serebía , Odaía , Sebnía , Phathathía :
traditions.KJV: Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabniah , Sherebiah , Hodijah , Shebaniah , [ and ] Pethahiah , said ,

5.english_reference: Stand up [ and ] bless the LORD your God for ever and ever :

traditions.WLC: ק֗וּמוּ בָּרֲכוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי כֶ֔ם מִן הָ עוֹלָ֖ם עַד הָ עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Ἀνάστητε , εὐλογεῖτε Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος ·
traditions.VUL: Súrgite , benedícite Dómino Deo vestro ab ætérno usque in ætérnum :
traditions.KJV: Stand up [ and ] bless the LORD your God for ever

5.english_reference: and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .

traditions.WLC: וִ יבָֽרְכוּ֙ שֵׁ֣ם כְּבוֹדֶ֔ ךָ וּ מְרוֹמַ֥ם עַל כָּל בְּרָכָ֖ה וּ תְהִלָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὐλογήσουσιν ὄνομα δόξης σου , καὶ ὑψώσουσιν ἐπὶ πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ καὶ αἰνέσει .
traditions.VUL: et benedícant nómini glóriæ tuæ excélso in omni benedictióne et laude .
traditions.KJV: and ever : and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἔσρας

6.english_reference: Thou , [ even ] thou , [ art ] LORD alone ;

traditions.WLC: אַתָּה ה֣וּא יְהוָה֮ לְ בַדֶּ ךָ֒
traditions.LXX: Σὺ εἶ αὐτὸς Κύριος μόνος ·
traditions.VUL: Tu ipse Dómine , solus ,
traditions.KJV: Thou , [ even ] thou , [ art ] LORD alone ;

6.english_reference: thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host ,

traditions.WLC: את עָשִׂ֡יתָ אֶֽת הַ שָּׁמַיִם֩ שְׁמֵ֨י הַ שָּׁמַ֜יִם וְ כָל צְבָאָ֗ ם
traditions.LXX: σὺ ἐποίησας τὸν οὐρανὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν στάσιν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: tu fecísti cælum , et cælum cælórum , et omnem exércitum eórum :
traditions.KJV: thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host ,

6.english_reference: the earth , and all [ things ] that [ are ] therein ,

traditions.WLC: הָ אָ֜רֶץ וְ כָל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָלֶ֨י הָ֙
traditions.LXX: τὴν γῆν καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ ,
traditions.VUL: terram , et univérsa quæ in ea sunt :
traditions.KJV: the earth , and all [ things ] that [ are ] therein ,

6.english_reference: the seas , and all that [ is ] therein ,

traditions.WLC: הַ יַּמִּים֙ וְ כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: τὰς θαλάσσας καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐταῖς ,
traditions.VUL: mária , et ómnia quæ in eis sunt :
traditions.KJV: the seas , and all that [ is ] therein ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֖ה מְחַיֶּ֣ה אֶת כֻּלָּ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ ζωοποιεῖς τὰ πάντα ·
traditions.VUL: et tu vivíficas ómnia hæc ,
traditions.KJV: and thou preservest them all ;

6.english_reference: and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .

traditions.WLC: וּ צְבָ֥א הַ שָּׁמַ֖יִם לְ ךָ֥ מִשְׁתַּחֲוִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ σοὶ προσκυνοῦσιν αἱ στρατεῖαι τῶν οὐρανῶν .
traditions.VUL: et exércitus cæli te adórat .
traditions.KJV: and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .

7.english_reference: Thou [ art ] the LORD the God , who didst choose Abram ,

traditions.WLC: אַתָּה הוּא֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֨רְתָּ֙ בְּ אַבְרָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: σὺ εἶ ὁ θεός , σὺ ἐξελέξω ἐν Ἀβρὰμ
traditions.VUL: Tu ipse Dómine Deus , qui elegísti Abram ,
traditions.KJV: Thou [ art ] the LORD the God , who didst choose Abram ,

7.english_reference: and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הוֹצֵאת֖ וֹ מֵ א֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξήγαγες αὐτὸν ἐκ τῆς χώρας τῶν Χαλδαίων ,
traditions.VUL: et eduxísti eum de igne Chaldæórum ,
traditions.KJV: and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees ,

7.english_reference: and gavest him the name of Abraham ;

traditions.WLC: וְ שַׂ֥מְתָּ שְּׁמ֖ וֹ אַבְרָהָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέθηκας αὐτῷ ὄνομα Ἀβραάμ .
traditions.VUL: et posuísti nomen eius Abraham :
traditions.KJV: and gavest him the name of Abraham ;

8.english_reference: And foundest his heart faithful before thee ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מָצָ֣אתָ אֶת לְבָב וֹ֮ נֶאֱמָ֣ן לְ פָנֶי ךָ֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὗρες τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ πιστὴν ἐνώπιόν σου ,
traditions.VUL: et invenísti cor eius fidéle coram te ,
traditions.KJV: And foundest his heart faithful before thee ,

8.english_reference: and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Jebusites , and the Girgashites ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כָר֨וֹת עִמּ֜ וֹ הַ בְּרִ֗ית לָ תֵ֡ת אֶת אֶרֶץ֩ הַ כְּנַעֲנִ֨י הַ חִתִּ֜י הָ אֱמֹרִ֧י וְ הַ פְּרִזִּ֛י וְ הַ יְבוּסִ֥י וְ הַ גִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέθου πρὸς αὐτὸν διαθήκην δοῦναι αὐτῷ τὴν γῆν τῶν Χαναναίων καὶ Χετταίων καὶ Ἀμορραίων καὶ Φερεζαίων καὶ Ἰεβουσαίων καὶ Γεργεσαίων
traditions.VUL: et percussísti cum eo fœdus , ut dares ei terram Chananǽi , Hethǽi , et Amorrhǽi , et Pherezǽi , et Iebusǽi , et Gergesǽi ,
traditions.KJV: and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Jebusites , and the Girgashites ,

8.english_reference: to give [ it , I say ] , to his seed ,

traditions.WLC: לָ תֵ֣ת לְ זַרְע֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: ut dares sémini eius :
traditions.KJV: to give [ it , I say ] , to his seed ,

8.english_reference: and hast performed thy words ; for thou [ art ] righteous :

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֨קֶם֙ אֶת דְּבָרֶ֔י ךָ כִּ֥י צַדִּ֖יק אָֽתָּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησας τοὺς λόγους σου , ὅτι δίκαιος σύ .
traditions.VUL: et implésti verba tua , quóniam iustus es .
traditions.KJV: and hast performed thy words ; for thou [ art ] righteous :

9.english_reference: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תֵּ֛רֶא אֶת עֳנִ֥י אֲבֹתֵ֖י נוּ בְּ מִצְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶδες τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Et vidísti afflictiónem patrum nostrórum in Ægýpto ,
traditions.KJV: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt ,

9.english_reference: and heardest their cry by the Red sea ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת זַעֲקָתָ֥ ם שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ עַל יַם סֽוּף
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν κραυγὴν αὐτῶν ἤκουσας ἐπὶ θάλασσαν ἐρυθράν .
traditions.VUL: clamorémque eórum audísti super mare Rubrum .
traditions.KJV: and heardest their cry by the Red sea ;

10.english_reference: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh ,

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ תִּתֵּן אֹתֹ֨ת וּ מֹֽפְתִ֜ים בְּ פַרְעֹ֤ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκας σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ , ἐν Φαραὼ
traditions.VUL: Et dedísti signa atque porténta in Pharaóne ,
traditions.KJV: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל עֲבָדָי ו֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et in univérsis servis eius ,
traditions.KJV: and on all his servants ,

10.english_reference: and on all the people of his land :

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל עַ֣ם אַרְצ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et in omni pópulo terræ illíus :
traditions.KJV: and on all the people of his land :

10.english_reference: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֥י הֵזִ֖ידוּ עֲלֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔγνως ὅτι ὑπερηφάνησαν ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ·
traditions.VUL: cognovísti enim quia supérbe égerant contra eos :
traditions.KJV: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them .

10.english_reference: So didst thou get thee a name ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּֽעַשׂ לְ ךָ֥ שֵׁ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησας σεαυτῷ ὄνομα ,
traditions.VUL: et fecísti tibi nomen ,
traditions.KJV: So didst thou get thee a name ,

traditions.LXX: ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη .
traditions.VUL: sicut et in hac die .
traditions.KJV: as [ it is ] this day .

11.english_reference: And thou didst divide the sea before them

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ יָּם֙ בָּקַ֣עְתָּ לִ פְנֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν ἔρηξας ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et mare divisísti ante eos ,
traditions.KJV: And thou didst divide the sea before them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְ תוֹךְ הַ יָּ֖ם בַּ יַּבָּשָׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρήλθοσαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς θαλάσσης ἐν ξηρασίᾳ ,

traditions.KJV: so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land ;

traditions.VUL: quasi lápidem in aquas válidas .

12.english_reference: and in the night by a pillar of fire

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ עַמּ֥וּד אֵשׁ֙ לַ֔יְלָה

traditions.KJV: and in the night by a pillar of fire ,

12.english_reference: to give them light in the way wherein they should go

traditions.KJV: to give them light in the way wherein they should go .

traditions.KJV: neither turned they from their wicked works .

36.english_reference: Behold , we [ are ] servants this day

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ הַ יּ֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Ecce nos ipsi hódie servi sumus :
traditions.KJV: Behold , we [ are ] servants this day ,

36.english_reference: and [ for ] the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ אָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֣תָּה לַ אֲבֹתֵ֗י נוּ לֶ אֱכֹ֤ל אֶת פִּרְיָ הּ֙ וְ אֶת טוּבָ֔ הּ
traditions.VUL: et terra , quam dedísti pátribus nostris ut coméderent panem eius , et quæ bona sunt eius ,
traditions.KJV: and [ for ] the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof ,

36.english_reference: behold , we [ are ] servants in it

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדִ֖ים עָלֶֽי הָ
traditions.VUL: et nos ipsi servi sumus in ea .
traditions.KJV: behold , we [ are ] servants in it :

37.english_reference: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins

traditions.WLC: וּ תְבוּאָתָ֣ הּ מַרְבָּ֗ה לַ מְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּה עָלֵ֖י נוּ בְּ חַטֹּאותֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.VUL: Et fruges eius multiplicántur régibus , quos posuísti super nos propter peccáta nostra :
traditions.KJV: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins :

37.english_reference: also they have dominion over our bodies , and over our cattle , at their pleasure

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֣ל גְּ֠וִיֹּתֵי נוּ מֹשְׁלִ֤ים וּ בִ בְהֶמְתֵּ֨ נוּ֙ כִּ רְצוֹנָ֔ ם
traditions.VUL: et corpóribus nostris dominántur , et iuméntis nostris secúndum voluntátem suam ,
traditions.KJV: also they have dominion over our bodies , and over our cattle , at their pleasure ,

37.english_reference: and we [ are ] in great distress

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ צָרָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה אֲנָֽחְנוּ
traditions.VUL: et in tribulatióne magna sumus .
traditions.KJV: and we [ are ] in great distress .
